2607.27069.title: Visual Credit Audit for Multimodal Spatial Reasoning
2607.27069.paper_summary: Closed yes/no spatial benchmarks can reward a correct answer even when the image adds little support beyond no-image contexts. Under a fixed forced-choice interface, Visual Credit Audit (VCA) separates two estimands: whether the benchmark image gives the model's declared decision more support than text-only and blank controls, and whether the model responds to relation-specific visual evidence. The first audit is training- and label-free and does not require an answer flip. Applying labels yields dependence-credited correctness (D-CC); on correct items, it equals same-control gold-aligned positive gain, while prediction alignment extends the audit to errors. Across four open MLLMs and two spatial benchmarks, 12.73-26.25% of decisions are correct yet uncredited. Matched same-split image permutation reduces D-CC by 21.25-47.80 points, with every paired 95% interval above zero. Fixed-pixel relation contrasts and a 3x3 evidence-source factorial show why null controls cannot identify relation response. Among controlled correct-but-uncredited agreement decisions, response to relation reversal spans 81.57-100.00%, while 32.11% pooled change answer. Independently audited outcomes on 108 geometry-compatible edits provide a bounded natural-image correspondence check. VCA thereby decomposes benchmark success into correctness, additional image support, and relation-consistent response.
2607.27069.paper_summary_zh: 封閉的是/否空間基準即使在圖像對於無圖像情境的支持有限的情況下，也能獎勵正確的回答。在固定的強制選擇介面下，視覺信用審計（VCA）將兩個估計量分開：基準圖像是否為模型的聲明決策提供了比僅有文本和空白控制更多的支持，以及模型是否對特定關係的視覺證據作出反應。第一次審計不需要訓練和標籤，也不需要答案翻轉。應用標籤會產生依賴信用的正確性（D-CC）；在正確項目上，它等於相同控制的金標準正向增益，而預測對齊則將審計擴展到錯誤。在四個開放的MLLM和兩個空間基準中，12.73-26.25%的決策是正確但未被記錄的。匹配的相同分割圖像排列將D-CC降低了21.25-47.80點，每對95%的區間均高於零。固定像素關係對比和3x3證據來源因子顯示為什麼無效控制無法識別關係反應。在受控的正確但未記錄的協議決策中，對關係反轉的反應範圍為81.57-100.00%，而32.11%的合併變更答案。對108個幾何兼容編輯的獨立審計結果提供了有限的自然圖像對應檢查。因此，VCA將基準成功分解為正確性、額外的圖像支持和關係一致的反應。
